University Coursework and Foreign Language Learning

Undergraduate Education

University of Kansas (Lawrence, KS)
I attended the University of Kansas where I studied Computer Science, Economics, and Mathematics. I received my Bachelor’s of Science in Computer Science with a focus in Economics, and minored in Mathematics.
The courses I took during undergraduate can be found here.

Higher Education

Pursuing a Master’s of Science in Computer Science

Continuing Education

Johnson County Community College (Overland Park, KS)
Outside of my primary focus of studies, I have taken courses through JCCC to supplement miscellaneous interests I have, namely foreign languages, but not limited to taking and passing the Motorcycle Safety Foundation course en route to obtaining my motorcycle license.

Foreign Languages

English (Native Speaker)
I am a native English speaker, born in the heart of the midwest in the United States.
Spanish (B2 Upper-Intermediate)
[eng] I began studying Spanish when I was 12, and continued through the age of 18, completing the Advanced Placement Spanish course, the highest course offered, at my high school.
[spa] Empecé a estudiar español a los 12 años, y continué hasta los 18, completando el curso de español de nivel avanzado, el más alto que se ofrecía, en mi instituto.
Mandarin (A2 Elementary)
[eng] During high school, I completed 1 year of beginning Mandarin. Since then, I have received some tutoring here and there, but plan to pick up where I left off and continue studying.
[zho] 我在高中学过一年中文。我想学习更多的中文.
Japanese (A2 Elementary)
[en] Following the completion of my undergraduate degree, I began studying Japanese at Johnson County Community College. After completing Elementary Japanese I and Elementary Japanese II, I continued studying with a tutor to hopefully pass the N1 one day.
[jpn] 大学卒業後、1年間日本語を勉強した, 今も日本語の勉強を続けています.
